name: skyra-log-hub
description: Skyra LogHub — Centralized Logging and Observability Platform

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @skyra/logger-core build && pnpm --filter @skyra/logger-node build && pnpm --filter @skyra/logger-nestjs build && pnpm --filter @skyra/logger-next build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @skyra/logger-core exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @skyra/logger-node exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @skyra/logger-nestjs exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @skyra/logger-next exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/contracts/schema-validation.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/logger-node/tests/**/*.test.ts && pnpm --filter @skyra/logger-nestjs test && pnpm --filter @skyra/logger-next test
